title: Improved Upper Bound for Lindström's Unique-Sum Problem
summary: Let $\{0,1\}^{n}$ denote the set of all $n$-dimensional vectors whose components are either $0$ or $1$. For any two nonempty subsets $\mathcal{X},\mathcal{Y}\subseteq\{0,1\}^{n}$, the pair $(\mathcal X,\mathcal Y)$ is called an $n$-dimensional unique-sum pair if each pair $(\boldsymbol x,\boldsymbol y)\in\mathcal X\times\mathcal Y$ can be uniquely determined from the arithmetic sum $\boldsymbol x+\boldsymbol y$.
